claim.es: RuleInstaller descarga con topes, extrae de forma segura (10 000 entradas, 160 MB expandidos, profundidad 16, 60 s), exige manifiesto idéntico al firmado, verifica con ChannelVerifier, recalcula hashes antes de activar y activa con dos renombrados con diario conservando la versión anterior; sin verificador Sigstore no instala nada.
claim.en: RuleInstaller downloads with caps, extracts safely (10,000 entries, 160 MB expanded, depth 16, 60 s), requires a manifest identical to the signed one, verifies with ChannelVerifier, re-hashes before activation and activates with two journalled renames keeping the previous version; without a Sigstore verifier it installs nothing.

claim.es: La verificación Sigstore usa el cosign oficial v3.1.1 como ayudante, ejecutado solo si su SHA-256 coincide con el fijado en el código, con una raíz de confianza incluida y sin red; falla cerrado. El ADR está aceptado con revisión humana pendiente.
claim.en: Sigstore verification uses the official cosign v3.1.1 as a helper, run only if its SHA-256 matches the one pinned in the code, with a bundled trust root and no network; it fails closed. The ADR is accepted with human review pending.

claim.en: The engine is YARA 4.5.8 as external yara and yarac executables (universal, macOS 13+, pinned static OpenSSL); hash, codesign --verify --strict, minimum version 4.5.0, architecture and a canary rule are verified. YARA-X is not used. Scan limits: 25,000,000 bytes per file and 2,000 files (maxFileBytes, maxFiles).
